title: Launched Realmforge today. Solving narrative memory and coherence is the hardest part.
author: teamrealmforge
selftext:
Hey all.

So happy to come here and tell all of you that we have launched Realmforge. It is a platform to create and play unscripted roleplaying games with AI.

It has been awfully hard to get the AI to produce engaging stories and remember details over long sessions, but we have made great progress on this (especially compared to other products out there)

We are currently doing only 2D animated visuals. We are banking on video models to become usable for our use case in the coming years, but right now the latency and cost is just too high for real time play.

Would love for you all to check it out.

Merry Christmas to all celebrating.
